999008199.text:
とりあえず、上手く潜入できたね。
でも、慎重に慎重を重ねないと……

localizations.en: Well, we managed to infiltrate successfully. But we need to be extra careful from here on out...

999008199.text: 任せときなさい、潜入もお手のものよ

localizations.en: Leave it to me—infiltration is my specialty.

999008199.text:
いつになくヨハナが生き生きしてる……
こっちはハンマー振り回せないっていうのに

localizations.en: Johanna seems unusually excited... Meanwhile, I can't even swing my hammer around here.

999008199.text:
指さし確認よし！
今のところは敵の姿もないね

localizations.en: All clear so far! No enemies in sight yet.

999008199.text:
ま、ヴァレリアたちのおかげで警備が薄いとはいえ、
牢に近づけば嫌でも戦うことになるでしょ

localizations.en: Well, thanks to Valeria and the others drawing away the guards, security's lighter. But once we get close to the prison, we'll have to fight whether we want to or not.

999008199.text:
こちらの狙いが人質奪還というのは
向こうも承知してるだろうしね

localizations.en: They know we're here for a rescue mission, after all.

999008199.text: 面白いじゃん。どういう展開になるんだろう

localizations.en: This is getting interesting. I wonder how it'll all play out.

999008199.text: ふふん、状況を楽しみすぎてちゃ一流とはいえないわよ

localizations.en: Heh, you can't call yourself first-rate if you're having too much fun with the situation.

999008199.text:
今回、連携できて嬉しいな。
イェルカさんが提案してくれたおかげだね

localizations.en: I'm really happy we can work together this time. Thank you for suggesting it, Jelka.

999008199.text: そういや、１つ言っておくことがある

localizations.en: Speaking of which, there's something I should mention.

999008199.text:
お前さんたちは勘違いしてるかもしれないけど、
別にアタシだって「管理」を押し付けたいわけじゃない

localizations.en: You might have the wrong idea, but it's not like we want to forcefully manage everyone either.

999008199.text: そうなんだ？　ちょっと意外

「管理」せずに済むんならそっちのほうがいいさ。
どうせ見守るならあれこれ手を出さずにいたい

localizations.en: If we didn't have to manage things, that'd be preferable. I'd rather just watch over things without interfering.

999008199.text:
観測者がいちいち介入するなんて
無粋もいいところだからね

localizations.en: Observers constantly meddling in affairs? Nothing kills the mood quite like that.

999008199.text: でも、こっちもそれが役目だからなぁ。いかんとも……

localizations.en: But hey, it's our job, so... there's not much we can do about it.

999008199.text: ……なんか愚痴り始めた？
なんか、鬱憤が溜まってるのかな……？

localizations.en: Sounds like you've got some pent-up frustration...?

999008199.text:
あ、これはイェルカ個人の感想だから。
みんながみんなそうじゃないからねー

localizations.en: Oh, this is just Jelka's personal opinion, by the way. Not everyone feels the same way.

999008199.text: 九偉人も色々な意見があるんですね

localizations.en: So even the Nine have different perspectives too.

999008199.text:
……ただまあ、今回のケイウンの場合は、
見過ごしておけないってのが共通認識さ

localizations.en: ...Though in Keiun's case, we all agree this can't be overlooked.

999008199.text:
まあね。だからアタシたちも
こうして首を突っ込んでるわけだし

localizations.en: True. That's why we're getting involved.

999008199.text:
だから短い間だけど共同戦線だよ。
みんな改めてよろしくね

localizations.en: So our goals align. It's a pleasure working alongside you.

999008199.text:
はい、とっても心強いです！
頼りにしてますね！

localizations.en: That's incredibly reassuring! We're counting on you!

999008199.text: さて……今回はどういう結末を迎えるのかな

localizations.en: Now then... I wonder how this will all end.
